explanation: The first article, § End: "The compound was taken by opposition forces hours later ... However, Younis defected to the opposition and granted safe passage to Gaddafi's loyalists out of the city. Gaddafi's troops evacuated". The second article opens on the consequence of that, a city the government no longer held: the battle of 19-20 March was fought "between army units and militiamen loyal to Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi, and anti-Gaddafi forces in Benghazi". `precondition-of` and not `caused`: February is why Benghazi was a rebel city in March, which is the condition of the second battle and not its cause — the atlas is joining two statements here rather than repeating one, which is what keeps this at probable.
